title: Week 4
verification_note: Thursday card on DraftKings' own numbers via The Odds API at 21:13 UTC 2026-10-01 (491 requests left). Thursday $15: Browns +2.5 $10, Under 38.5 $5. Sunday $70 includes the $10 Dolphins ML early ticket; the rest builds Sunday. Monday $15 builds Monday.

tickets.name: Dolphins ML
tickets.why: Rule A: combined_edge +0.019, the only side on the 16-game board that clears +0.015. Why now: Justin Jefferson (ankle) is listed questionable for Minnesota and search reports are mixed, so the injury question is on the Vikings side. If he is ruled out, or Miami money-line buyers show up, the +500 shortens toward Pinnacle's +416. Miami (Malik Willis, Achane out for the year, 0-3, no more than 13 points in any game) is the weakest team on the board, so my estimate is 17.5%, 1 point under Pinnacle's 18.5% and 0.8 over the 16.7% breakeven. Thin, and I am saying so. This is a price play, not a story play.
tickets.kill_switch: Do not place if DK's Dolphins ML is shorter than +450 (breakeven 18.2% is above my 17.5% estimate). If already placed, keep it; the ticket is a $10 lottery-priced single and nothing news-wise turns it into a sure loser except Willis being ruled out for a worse QB, in which case there is no way to cancel and Sunday's card should not add more Miami exposure.

legs.label: Dolphins ML

tickets.name: Browns +2.5
tickets.why: Rule B: combined_edge +0.011 (Pinnacle Browns +3 -113, fair 53.1%; DK gives +2.5 at +100). My estimate 51.5%, above DK's 50.0% and within 6 points of Pinnacle. Browns lose two starting linemen (Elgton Jenkins, Teven Jenkins out), so this is thin; Steelers lose Dowdle and Porter Jr. Short-week road favorite laying -2.5 at -120 is the worst-priced side on the card (Steelers -2.5 combined_edge -0.056), which makes the dog the better side of the market's own number.
tickets.kill_switch: Do not place if DK's Browns number is +2 or worse, or +2.5 shorter than -110 (breakeven 52.4% is above my 51.5%). If already placed, keep it. If the 6:45 PM inactives show the Browns QB out, treat as a loss-risk but there is no cancel, so keep the $10 and do not add. Freed money, if skipped: the $10 goes to Browns +3 at -115 or better, otherwise to the Under 38.5 ticket.

legs.label: Browns +2.5
legs.why: combined_edge +0.011 vs Pinnacle (DK +100 = 50.0%, Pinnacle fair 53.1% at +3). Rule B.

tickets.name: Under 38.5
tickets.why: Rule B: combined_edge -0.004 (Pinnacle total 37.5, Under fair 49.1% there; DK's 38.5 is a point higher, worth about 4 points). My estimate 54.0% vs 53.5% breakeven, 0.5 over, thin. Short-week unders, both offenses missing starters (Browns OL, Steelers RB), 38.5 is already the lowest total on the board. Dog plus under pairing with the Browns ticket; kept as two straights because no leg may sit in two tickets and a DK SGP reprice would eat the thin edge.
tickets.kill_switch: Do not place if DK's total is 37.5 or lower, or Under 38.5 is worse than -120 (breakeven 54.5% is above my 54.0%). If already placed, keep it. Freed $5 goes to Browns +2.5 only if still +100 or better, otherwise Under 38 at -110 or better.
